verdict.rationale: BVNK's own docs describe a payment mode where stablecoin payments are accepted and fiat lands in the merchant account, with BVNK handling conversion and settlement. Separate fiat payout docs cover sending to first- or third-party bank accounts. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring auto-conversion or settlement currency per payment, explicit evidence of automatic sweeps to an external bank payout, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can take crypto payments but settle in fiat — a documented option to auto-convert stablecoin receipts into a fiat balance or bank payout so my books never hold crypto

citations.quote: Crypto converted and received in fiat: Accept stablecoin payments from customers and receive fiat currency in your account
BVNK manages the conversion and settlement to your accounts
Accept payments globally in stablecoins. Settle in fiat.
It is possible to create both a payout to themselves (first party) or a payout to another bank account (third party).
